description: Create a text box on a slide and fill it with text.

height.description: Optional height of the text box in points (default 60).

presentation_id.description: The unique identifier of the presentation containing the slide.

slide_id.description: The object ID of the slide to create the text box on.

text.description: The text to place inside the new text box.

width.description: Optional width of the text box in points (default 300).

x.description: Optional horizontal position of the text box in points (default 50).

y.description: Optional vertical position of the text box in points (default 50).

name: create_textbox
